subject: DYNAMIC LENGTH clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.19.3 "If dynamic-length-structure-name-1 is not specified, the structure of the dynamic-length elementary item is defined by the implementor." OK (SR3); cite.py --check 8.5.1.10.2 "In the absence of a dynamic-length-structure-name the internal structure is defined by the implementor." OK. The implementor structure is the native .NET string carrier (StorageForm.DynamicString, no length prefix or delimiter, DynStructure null, max = MaxLength); every unnamed-structure golden (dynamic_length_item, dynamic_length_limit) compiles and runs. cite.py --check A.1 "Dynamic-length elementary items (structure if dynamic-length-structure-name-1 is not specified). This item is required. This item need not be documented" OK (A.1 item 63): the item is REQUIRED but NEED NOT BE DOCUMENTED, so kb/Work PB991 (open, claims this row) rests on a false premise where it says the row 'Needs the A.1 documentation row' - documentation is optional, and the binder path already applies the structure. Where the structure becomes byte-observable (a file record) is determination D-FRA (PB981). Recommend PB991 close this row on this adjudication; its GR-12.3.7.4-19 half is unaffected. || Editions (adjudicator): 2014, 2023 (COBOL-2014 introduction per VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE; the 2023 Annex E lists only the 2023 SET enhancement for dynamic-length items, E.3 item 17)
